about.title: About Lawyer / Mohammed Al-Shaikh
about.intro_subtitle: Extensive experience in representing employees and workers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
about.description: A licensed Saudi lawyer from the Ministry of Justice, professionally accredited by the Saudi Bar Association, fully specialized in labor law. Has handled numerous complex labor cases against major companies, banks, and institutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Provides comprehensive legal services to employees and workers facing labor disputes, whether wrongful termination, wage non-payment, or claiming their full legal rights.
